notes.title: Time for a new update!
notes.content:
Hey Little cells fans,

Despite the date, It's not a joke, a new update is finally here!

We talked about this update last summer in the previous "Community Announcements", and well, it took us way longer than expected to release our Android version first.
The game was actually ready and finished at the beginning of September 2016, according to plans. However we had to work on the Google Play Achievements and Leaderboard to be on par with the Steam version. That took us until end of February, with an Android Release that happened March 6th 2017. So you know, you can find the game for your Android devices here:
https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.fullybugged.littlecells

The Steam version has now been updated to contain all the improvements of the Android version, while keeping the higher quality of the computer version.

Thanks again for all your feedback and reviews. We're reading them and trying to learn from it to improve this game or the next one to come.

Enjoy the spring, enjoy the sun!

Cheers!

notes.title: First small game update
notes.content:
Hi Guys,


First of all, thank you very much for playing our game.
We are amazed by the high scores on the leaderboards ... some of them are out of this world!

We are not giving lots of news, but we continue to work on the game in addition to a port for mobile devices.

A sound update has been made today, with new music tracks from Jérôme Angelot in the menu and score pages. Jérôme was already responsible for the in-game music and recently had the time to create two new tracks for us, giving the overall game a better balance.

Check it out now and tell us what you think!
